name: get_work_request
summary: Read one dispatch request from this native private Agent's coordination Session by source Run and tool call. The server resolves the unique full run/turn/call identity. notRecorded means no trusted committed success was found; it does not authorize repeating or rebuilding the request. pending means a committed request has no admission yet, including retained rewritten requests. admitted means hosted admission exists, not that work completed. Source projection and child availability/status are separate facts. This query never starts or repairs work.
